title: Riverbend County — RFP for Construction Manager at Risk, Public Safety Building
labelled_by: Claude (AI), written together with the synthetic document; independent human review pending
notes: Authored for this evaluation to mirror common solicitation structures; not a real procurement.

requirements.quote: Deadline for written questions: April 17, 2026, 4:00 p.m.
Proposals due: May 1, 2026, 2:00 p.m.
Proposals must be submitted electronically through the County's eProcurement portal as a single PDF file
Proposals shall not exceed twenty-five (25) pages, excluding the cover letter, resumes, and required forms
Pages shall be 8.5 x 11 inches with a minimum font size of 11 points
organized in the order of the tabs in Section 4, with tabs labeled to match
Provide a cover letter signed by an officer authorized to bind the firm
The cover letter shall not exceed two (2) pages
Describe your firm's experience as CMAR on at least three public safety, justice, or comparable civic facilities completed in the last ten years
Identify the proposed project executive, project manager, superintendent, and preconstruction manager
Include a one-page resume for each
Describe your approach to estimating, value engineering, constructability review, and developing the Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP)
Provide your firm's Experience Modification Rate (EMR) for each of the last three years
Describe your site safety program, including subcontractor safety oversight
using Attachment B, Fee Proposal Form, uploaded as a separate file
signed Conflict of Interest Disclosure (Attachment C)
Vendor Registration Certificate (Attachment D)
Proposers must hold a current general contractor license issued by the State
demonstrate bonding capacity of at least $60 million for a single project, evidenced by a letter from a surety
Firm qualifications and relevant experience — 30 points
Key personnel — 25 points
Preconstruction approach — 20 points
Safety record — 10 points
Fee proposal — 15 points

traps.quote: The County shall provide the selected firm with design documents at each design phase
traps.why: Obligation or right of the owner, not the bidder

traps.quote: The County may, at its sole discretion, cancel this RFP
traps.why: Obligation or right of the owner, not the bidder
